verdict.rationale: Relay is a business banking SaaS, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and no public API at all. The llms.txt file found by the probe is a documentation summary for LLMs, not an API specification, and the Plaid, QuickBooks and Xero integrations are adjacent features that earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
